## F13.fork-branch — Fork or branch a session

Definition: Starting a new line from an existing session.
- claude-code [supported, verified] With --resume or --continue, --fork-session creates a new session ID instead of reusing the original; the SDK forkSession option does the same when resuming with resume. /branch branches the current conversation to try a different direction, and /fork copies it into a new background session. | ev: E-claude-code-07054, E-claude-code-00966, E-claude-code-07208
- codex-cli [supported, verified] `codex fork` forks a previous interactive session into a new chat; by default it opens the session picker, and `--last` forks the most recent session. The `/fork` slash command copies a local chat into a new local chat or worktree. App-server `thread/fork` copies stored history into a new thread id; `ephemeral: true` makes an in-memory fork. | ev: E-codex-cli-01166, E-codex-cli-02072, E-codex-cli-00209
- copilot-cli [supported, verified] `/fork` forks the current session into a new session, optionally with a name, and is usable while the agent is running; the source session keeps working in the background. `/fork worktree` forks the session, preserving its conversation context, into a new Git worktree that always branches off `HEAD`. | ev: E-copilot-cli-00918, E-copilot-cli-01285, E-copilot-cli-00920
- copilot-vscode [partial, verified] /fork branches the conversation with its history. Hovering over a request and selecting Fork Conversation creates an independent session that includes the conversation up to that checkpoint. A fork inherits the source conversation up to the fork point, and the original conversation remains available. | limit: Forking doesn't guarantee separate code changes; a fork can share the original session and worktree (E-copilot-vscode-00396), whereas E-copilot-vscode-02592 describes the fork as an independent session. | ev: E-copilot-vscode-02434, E-copilot-vscode-00396, E-copilot-vscode-02592, E-copilot-vscode-00537
- cursor [supported, unverified] `/fork` forks the current chat into a new session. Forking the whole chat, from the tab menu, sidebar, or command palette, copies every message and subagent; forking from a specific message copies the conversation through that message. - gemini-cli [supported, unverified] Save the current state with /resume save decision-point, then use /resume resume decision-point to fork the conversation back. ## F13.transcript-storage — Transcript storage

Definition: Where session history is stored and in what format.
- claude-code [supported, unverified] Claude Code saves conversations locally. The subprocess writes each batch of transcript entries to local disk first; the SDK then forwards it to your store's append(), so the store mirrors the local transcript. Subagent transcripts are stored in separate files. /export exports the current conversation as plain text. | ev: E-claude-code-02230, E-claude-code-00775, E-claude-code-00866, E-claude-code-07252
- codex-cli [supported, verified] Codex can save session transcripts under `CODEX_HOME`; `history.persistence` and `history.max_bytes` are the local data retention settings to review if you don't want that. The config and state locations list `history.jsonl` (if history persistence is enabled). `history.max_bytes` caps the history file; oldest entries are trimmed when exceeded. | ev: E-codex-cli-00160, E-codex-cli-02962, E-codex-cli-00983
- copilot-cli [supported, unverified] Copilot CLI stores session data locally on your machine and by default syncs sessions to your GitHub account; setting session syncing and remote access to `off` keeps data local only. A compaction checkpoint is saved as a numbered, titled file in the session's workspace. `--share` saves the full session transcript to a Markdown file on the local filesystem. | ev: E-copilot-cli-02732, E-copilot-cli-00170, E-copilot-cli-02341, E-copilot-cli-01240
- copilot-vscode [partial, verified] VS Code maintains a searchable history of Copilot sessions and by default syncs local agent sessions to the user's GitHub account. When session sync is disabled by organization policy, session data is kept local only. Hook input can carry an optional absolute path to a file that contains the conversation transcript. | limit: Transcript formats are not a stable cross-harness API. | ev: E-copilot-vscode-02657, E-copilot-vscode-01184, E-copilot-vscode-02324, E-copilot-vscode-01654
- cursor [supported, unverified] Cursor stores agent chat history locally; conversation state, metadata and artifacts are also saved to Cursor-managed storage. Hooks receive `transcript_path`, the path to the main conversation transcript file (null if transcripts disabled). In the Python SDK, `run.conversation()` returns a typed `list[ConversationTurn]` and `run.conversation_json()` returns the raw JSON string. | ev: E-cursor-01514, E-cursor-02313, E-cursor-00864, E-cursor-01158
- gemini-cli [supported, verified] By default, Gemini CLI stores configuration and history in ~/.gemini. Every session is recorded locally as a transcript.
